This 
document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed 
on a daily bases as indicated by D1 in the title block.

The
 Brush Dimension 25x32x64 mm, Rated Current Density 9.5 A/cm2, 
 Brush Holders R2532

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, tested by eng. Enas Azmy, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Tawfik El sayed Tawfik, accepted by eng. Aly Abdel Whab; general 
director, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman 
EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director and 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass 
 ... etc.
يجب أن تكون الوحدة في الخدمة.

العمل المراد تنفيذه

فحص 
اهتزاز الفرشاة.

Inspect 
the sparking brushes.
Inspect brush holders and slip rings.

Check brushes must move freely in the holders and must sit 
 to the rings by their full surface.

Check brush pressure in permanently given by the 
 holding-down system of the holders.
Check connection of cables of brushes must be tightened.

The 
 brush is replaced by new one if its height falls to 25 mm.
